description: This file defines the IMediaPipelineClient interface, an abstract class for media pipeline clients to receive notifications about media playback events such as duration, position, native size, network state, playback state, media data availability, QoS updates, and buffer underflow events. It also includes constants for special duration values and references external types like NetworkState, PlaybackState, MediaPlayerShmInfo, and QosInfo.

classes.name: IMediaPipelineClient
classes.description: An abstract base class for media pipeline clients to implement notification methods for media events.

methods.name: notifyDuration
methods.description: Notify the total duration of the media in nanoseconds, or a special value if unknown or unending.

methods.name: notifyPosition
methods.description: Notify the current playback position in nanoseconds.

methods.name: notifyNativeSize
methods.description: Notify the native size of the video and pixel aspect ratio.

methods.name: notifyVideoData
methods.description: Notify whether video data is available.

methods.name: notifyAudioData
methods.description: Notify whether audio data is available.

methods.name: notifyNeedMediaData
methods.description: Notify that media data is needed, providing source ID, frame count, request ID, and shared memory info.

methods.name: notifyCancelNeedMediaData
methods.description: Cancel any outstanding media data request for a given source ID.

methods.name: notifyQos
methods.description: Notify a QoS update from the player, including source ID and QoS info.

methods.name: notifyBufferUnderflow
methods.description: Notify that a buffer underflow has occurred for a given source ID.
